notes: PAP reference G44/0509. Whole 48.36 m2 two-room apartment on the fifth floor of an eight-floor residence with lift and caretaker near central Orleans. The complete advert describes an entrance with storage, south-east living room opening to a 10-12 m2 wraparound balcony, independent fitted kitchen, bedroom, dressing area, shower room and separate WC. The sale includes a basement parking space and an approximately 6 m2 cellar. It states collective heating, annual condominium charges of EUR 3,360 including heating and water, and property tax of about EUR 1,300. PAP exposed 17 property photos plus a virtual tour and a publication date of 29 September 2026.

PAP reference G54/2013. Whole two-room-plus-office apartment with 48 m2 Carrez on the top floor of an older building in Caen's historic centre. The complete advert describes a 22.61 m2 living room with open fitted kitchen and access to a 7.5 m2 balcony, an 11.13 m2 bedroom, a separate 7.73 m2 office and bathroom. A private cellar, 5.89 m2 attic and covered bicycle room are included. It states DPE D, annual condominium charges of about EUR 768, property tax of EUR 810 and no private parking. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 26 September 2026.

PAP reference G05/1649. Whole four-room apartment with 75.99 m2 habitable area on the first floor in central Chartres. The complete advert describes three bedrooms, a fitted kitchen with a small south-facing balcony converted into a loggia, a shower room and an open living area. It states that the apartment was fully renovated in 2021 and has collective gas heating, double glazing, a cellar, a garage box and shared visitor parking. PAP exposed 10 property photos and a publication date of 17 September 2026.

PAP reference G01/0013. Whole two-room ground-floor apartment in a four-floor building in Orleans' Saint-Marceau district. The complete advert describes one bedroom, a bathroom, a fitted kitchen open to the living room, entrance storage and large bay windows. The sale includes a basement parking space, and the residence has a lift and intercom. It states individual electric heating, DPE C, annual charges of EUR 800 and property tax of EUR 975. The apartment is stated available from August 2026, before this review date. PAP exposed 10 property photos and a publication date of 10 September 2026.

PAP reference G50/1883. Whole four-room top-floor apartment with lift in a secured residence in Orleans. The complete advert describes a 41.04 m2 living and dining room with open fitted kitchen, 37 m2 terrace, 15.81 m2 principal bedroom with private shower room, two additional bedrooms, bathroom and separate WC. A cellar, closed garage box and outdoor parking space are included. It states electric heating, DPE D and condominium charges of EUR 170 per month. PAP exposed 11 property photos and a publication date of 5 September 2026.
